summary: Iteration 9 — Razorpay Standard Checkout (Part A, backend only). Wrote 17 pytest cases covering /config, /orders (happy + idempotent + amount_below_minimum + no_dues + caps-at-dues), /verify (valid + invalid sig + unknown order + idempotent), /status (after-verify + unknown-cid 404), /checkout HTML, and /webhooks (bad_signature + payment.captured reconciliation + dedup + payment.failed). ALL 17 razorpay tests pass. Regression: 112/112 pass when run serially (`-n 0`); 95/95 pre-existing tests are green in isolation. The xdist parallel-mode flake surfaces without Razorpay tests too (test_ride91_backend.py TestCC/TestKK cross-worker share the demo driver's inspection row) — pre-existing, documented in iteration 5 & 6, unrelated to Part A.

minor.issue: The 503 branch (`RAZORPAY_KEY_ID` empty → 503 razorpay_not_configured) was NOT exercised end-to-end — patching the server-process env from an out-of-process HTTP test isn't possible without restarting supervisor. Code path is code-reviewed and matches the spec: `if not _razorpay_configured(): raise HTTPException(503, 'razorpay_not_configured')` at server.py:2238. Coverage gap is a test-harness limitation, not a bug.

Cannot monkeypatch httpx.AsyncClient inside a live out-of-process backend from a requests-based test suite. Happy-path / idempotency / caps tests instead exercise Razorpay's TEST mode API (rzp_test_* keys are exactly for this — no money moves, no third-party side effects). All three tests validate that the row lands in Mongo with the correct amount_paise and that the returned order_id starts with 'order_'. This is a deliberate deviation from the review request phrasing ('stub outbound Razorpay') — flagging so main agent knows.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: add an in-process test harness (FastAPI TestClient importing server.app) so httpx to Razorpay can be monkeypatched; the current out-of-process HTTP harness cannot mock outbound calls, and we relied on Razorpay's test-mode network for /orders creation.

Optional: pre-existing xdist LoadScope flake between TestCC_InspectionGate and TestKK_InspectionToday in test_ride91_backend.py (they share the demo driver's inspection_today row across workers). Serial (`-n 0`) run is clean 112/112. Documented in iteration 5 & 6 already.

Optional server.py micro-refactor: in POST /payments/razorpay/orders, the idempotent replay short-circuit doesn't hit Razorpay a second time (verified via test_orders_idempotent_replay), which matches the spec. No fix needed.
critical_code_review_comments: HMAC verification uses hmac.compare_digest — constant-time, good.
Webhook signature is computed on the RAW body before json.loads — correct order.
Webhook dedup key is `event.id` with a unique constraint via insert_one/except — the dedup contract holds even if two identical events race (second insert throws → returns {ok:true, dedup:true}).

Reconciliation is atomic via find_one_and_update({'status':{'$ne':'reconciled'}}) — only the first transition writes qr_payments. The qr_payments upsert then uses (driver_id, client_action_id) uniqueness with $setOnInsert to keep the deposit row single. Both layers of idempotency verified in tests.
amount capping logic (server.py:2138) handles the (dues>0, req>dues) case with min(req, dues) — verified with dues=100 & req=500 → 10000 paise.
GET /payments/razorpay/checkout is unauthenticated by design (bearer can't traverse a WebView) — the HMAC on /verify is the real auth. Confirmed with a quick e2e signature round-trip.

One minor note: /orders returns `key_id` in the response (server.py:2126, 2170) which is fine since it's already public — but callers can also get it from /config; consider dropping to reduce duplication. Non-blocking.

success_rate.backend: 100% (17/17 new Razorpay tests + 95/95 pre-existing when run serially; xdist parallel flake pre-exists and is unrelated to Part A)

seed_data_creation: Class-scoped fixture `rzp_driver` seeds a dedicated TEST_ driver + TEST_ session token directly in Mongo (so we never touch the demo driver's real cash-in-hand). Dues are controlled per-test via TEST_-prefixed platform_cash rows. All TEST_ data (drivers, sessions, platform_cash, qr_payments, razorpay_orders, webhook_events) is cleaned up in the fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Razorpay backend is production-ready for test-mode. The 503 branch on /checkout and any live-httpx-stubbing tests require an in-process TestClient harness — not present in this repo. If Part B (frontend Pay-dues sheet + expo-web-browser flow) lands next, drive it via web preview: POST /orders → open /api/payments/razorpay/checkout?... in a browser → simulate Razorpay's checkout.js handler by calling /verify with a valid HMAC directly (Razorpay's checkout.js needs a real browser & test card; keep it out of playwright).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found in Part A. All 17 spec cases pass; 2 minor coverage-gaps documented above are test-harness limitations, not product bugs.
